title: Ester Naming Convention
text: Esters are named as: [alkyl group from alcohol] + [name from acid with -oate ending]

title: Breaking Down the Name
text: Ethanol (C$$_2$$H$$_5$$OH) provides the ethyl- group. Propanoic acid (C$$_2$$H$$_5$$COOH) provides the propanoate part (change -oic acid to -oate).
